sentences.text: This {stage} {sex} ribbon seal carried his tag for {days_tracked}, from {first_date} to {last_date}.
Ribbon seals spend most of the year in open water and haul out on sea ice in spring to give birth and moult.
On {farthest_date} he was {max_displacement_km} from where his track began: {species_rank_distance}.
His record also holds {longest_gap_days} without a single position.
Why the tag went quiet isn't recorded. The map shows the gap as a dashed line, not a guessed route.
